newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian state funds swap shares worth 253 mln DEM.
newsitem.headline: Croatian state funds swap shares worth 253 mln DEM.

text.p: Croatia's privatisation agency and the pension fund will swap share packages worth 253 million German marks ($141.1 million) to rearrange and better handle their portfolios, the Privatisation Fund's officials said on Friday.
"The intention is that each of us get rid of small portions of different stocks and acquire a majority package for some stocks," spokesman Neven Andrilovic told Reuters.

The Fund said in a statement its outgoing package included shares of two newspapers -- the best selling daily Vecernji List and Glas Slavonije -- hotelier Liburnia, drugs firm Saponija Osijek and shipper Losinjska Plovidba.
The pension fund offered shares of hoteliers Arenaturist, Jadran, Helios and Maestral, cinema distributors Kinematografi Zagreb, dairy firm Ledo and shipyard Viktor Lenac.
"This way we can more easily manage the sale of particular stocks on our portfolio," Andrilovic said, adding the deal would be realised soon.
